title: Tile Installation Invoice Template
subtitle: An invoice pre-filled for tile work — installation, labor, grouting, demo, waterproofing and materials. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 14 — payment due within 14 days. Late fee of 1.5% per month applies after the due date.
notes: Thank you for your business. Grout sealer warranty applies per manufacturer; labor guaranteed for 90 days.
features: Auto-calculating tax formulas in Excel (just enter your state rate)
Pre-filled tile work line items: installation, labor, grouting, demo, waterproofing, materials
License # field — most states require a contractor license on client-facing invoices
Warranty-friendly layout: separate labor and materials lines

faqs.q: What should I include on a tile installation invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name and license number, the client and job-site address, a dated line-item list (installation, labor, grouting, demo, materials), tax, and a total due. Split labor and materials so warranty terms are easy to reference.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if you are not required to charge sales tax.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your contractor board and a CPA or attorney before use.
